name: latest
body: # New Design # Added Fixes Tag # Steps for install flatpak version: - run this command: ``` curl -sSL https://trinity-la.github.io/install-launcher | bash ``` # FOR NIXOS USERS Read [STEPS FOR RUN ON NIXOS OR USING NIX](https://codeberg.org/javiercplus/Trinity-Launcher-NIXOS/src/branch/main/) # FOR MAC USERS Download and extract trinity-macos-dmg [Click to download DMG x86_64](https://github.com/Trinity-LA/Trinity-Launcher/releases/download/2.6-beta/trinity-macos-x86_64-dmg.zip) [Click to download DMG ARM](https://github.com/Trinity-LA/Trinity-Launcher/releases/download/2.6-beta/trinity-macos-arm64-dmg.zip) Steps to run on terminal cd /Applications/Trinity.app/Contents/MacOS/ ./trinity-bin Troubleshooting If you have message "Trinity not opened ; Apple could not verify Trinity is free of malware", just go to System Settings>Privacy & Security, go down, and you should see "Trinity was locked" and Open Anyway, click Open Anyway -Make sure the app is on app folder # Sign in with a Microsoft account 1. In the game, go to: **Settings** > **Account** and enable the **Use Remote Connect for Microsoft Account Sign-in** option. Then, restart the game. 2. Click **Sign In** in the bottom-left corner; this will open a pop-up window with the URL that you need to visit. https://microsoft.com/link 4. On the page, enter the remote sign-in code and follow the usual steps to access your account. 5. When finished, return to the game and close the pop-up window. That’s it—you’re now signed in to your Minecraft account.

Short command:
``` 
curl -sSL https://trinity-la.github.io/install-launcher | bash
```  
Long command :
```
flatpak remote-add trinity https://github.com/Trinity-LA/Trinity-Launcher/releases/download/flatpak/com.trench.trinity.launcher.flatpakrepo
flatpak install flathub org.kde.Platform//6.10 io.qt.qtwebengine.BaseApp//6.10 -y
flatpak install com.trench.trinity.launcher -y

```
